title: Grateful Dead Live at Shoreline Amphitheatre on 1989-06-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (WAV 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/24
taper: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Good matrix recording of a rough Shoreline show, highlighted by Brent's erratic keys and a quirky Hey Pocky Way → Aiko jam.
ai_review.review: The UltraMatrix source captures the performance with clear sound quality despite the chaotic start, but the concert itself is considered below average. Reviewers note Brent’s over‑driven keyboard work and a strange Saint of Circumstance set, while Jerry’s segue into Hey Pocky Way → Aiko provides the only real bright spot.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is good (≈4/5) but the musical performance is rated poorly (≈2.5/5); weighted average yields a ~3‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as fine/excellent quality board with no major issues; clear and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three consecutive openers at the start due to technical gremlins made for a rough beginning; overall performance felt disjointed.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Bails out the set by leading Hey Pocky Way into Aiko, providing a rare highlight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's playing is described as hard and erratic ('wasted'), detracting from the show.
